RagShortTexts: Nanai-vandak ordered delivered musk divided into shares of three, one and one.

Variants.Content: Nanai-vandak instructed that a consignment of musk be divided into five shares after delivery: three to one recipient and one each to two others. Ownership, carriage and allocation appeared together. Arrival of a caravan did not itself settle the partners’ accounts; the goods still had to be handed over.
